subject: general
question: Chief of Defence Staff General Anil Chauhan has recently inaugurated various infrastructure at Karwar Naval Base. The development of this base comes under which project?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Project Seabird.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **General Anil Chauhan, Chief of Defence Staff, inaugurated key infrastructure at Naval Base Karwar under Phase IIA of Project Seabird.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Project Seabird is India's largest naval infrastructure project, aimed at enhancing the operational capabilities of the Indian Navy.**
 
• Phase IIA of the project includes berthing for ships and submarines, a dual-use Naval Air Station, a full-fledged Naval Dockyard, and logistics facilities.
 
• The ongoing construction has created 7,000 direct and 25,000 indirect jobs, aligning with the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative.
 
• The project adheres to environmental norms set by the MoEF&CC and the Indian Green Building Council (IGBC).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Project Varsha__

 __
 
• A naval project for developing India's strategic submarine base near Visakhapatnam.
 
 
 
• Project Samudra__
 __
 
• A project related to naval oceanographic research and surveillance.
 
 
 
• Project Blue Water__
 
 
• An initiative focused on India's maritime security and power projection capabilities.
